finding: The HTTP bodies contained the intended text but used Windows CRLF line endings. The runner constants expected LF because the fixture was intended to be byte-deterministic, while Path.write_text translated the newline on Windows.
resolution: The disposable fixture builder now uses write_bytes for registered path-fixture contents. The original result.json is preserved unchanged, and a new baseline run is required.
symlink_observation: PATH-S06 remains inconclusive in this run because Windows denied symlink creation with WinError 1314. This is independent of the newline defect.
